decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-aae2a6aa6ee6], is a one-line changelog entry: "fix: New kube applier for server side diff dry run with refactoring", with links to PRs #21488/#21749. It doesn't say what was wrong before, what behaviour changed, which configurations are affected (for example, apps that use server-side diff), or what happens if an operator does nothing. The PR descriptions or code diff are needed to identify the subject, the before/after change, who is exposed and the consequence.
